map.：取光束角 25°、投射距离 10m、中心光强 50000 cd。半角 12.5: : take a 25 degree beam angle, a 10 m throw and a centre intensity of 50000 cd. The half angle is 12.5 degrees, so the spot radius = 10 x tan(12.5 degrees) = 2.22 m, diameter = 4.43 m and lit area = 15.44 m2; centre illuminance = 50000 / 10^2 = 500.0 lux (about 50.0 fc). A 25 degree beam is medium (15-30 degrees), covering roughly 7% (on a 360 degree basis).
